title: Public repository explainer
command: Explain how Express works, how to run it, its request/response API, and how its tests are organized. Cite files and line ranges.
description: A master delegates to four specialists, each of whom spawns two file researchers.

specialists.title: Architecture specialist
specialists.goal: Explain the execution path from application creation to request handling.

specialists.title: Setup specialist
specialists.goal: Give setup commands grounded in the pinned source. Do not execute code.

researchers.title: README reader
researchers.question: Extract the documented installation and first example.

researchers.title: Manifest reader
researchers.question: Extract Node requirements, scripts, and runtime dependencies.

researchers.title: Request reader
researchers.question: Explain representative request helpers and their contracts.

researchers.title: Response reader
researchers.question: Explain representative response helpers and their contracts.

specialists.title: Testing specialist
specialists.goal: Explain how a new contributor should validate a change.

researchers.title: Test reader
researchers.question: Describe the test structure with exact file evidence.

researchers.title: Test contract reader
researchers.question: Explain asserted request behavior and test conventions using file and line evidence.
